Lydia Wright

Preserved Primary Document • wright-l.htm

Lydia Ann Wright was born in Sussex Co., DE. on 2 February, 1848. She was the daughter of Philip Wright . Sometime before 1870 she married Robert B. Jackson . Robert's occupation was listed as "seaman" but by 1880 the family was living in Milford Hundred, Sussex Co., DE and Robert's occupation was listed as "farmer".
